item.title: Goodbye, Roblox
item.description:
Hi everyone,

I just wanted to put it in writing that I’ve pretty much distanced myself from Roblox development indefinitely. This is due to the seemingly unending stream of terrible changes that Roblox has implemented over the past couple of months. I don’t like feeling like I’m constantly walking on eggshells, and I doubt anyone else does either. That feeling being widespread is incredibly detrimental to the health of a platform. This is a sentiment I’ve held for much longer than I’m comfortable admitting, and it seems that I’ll hold it for much, much longer. Is it worth exhausting hours of effort into a project only for the platform it’s on to nuke it – just like that?

I will not take down any of my Roblox assets. I don’t believe there’s any benefit to doing so, and I don’t want it to appear that I want to “punish” anybody. However, you might as well consider them on life support until further notice. As always, you’re more than welcome to continue using them if you wish. If any of my assets do get taken down, however, know that Roblox did it. You can continue to download them on the PVC Ko-fi Shop.

I am forever thankful for everyone in the circles I’ve been a part of who inspired and was inspired by my creations. I tend to feel like I’m shouting into a void, so it truly means a lot to me that at least one person found my stuff useful for a project of their own.

Regards,
PV

What about ETS2 and ATS?

As tough as it is loving these games – more on that later – this won’t affect any of my ETS2 or ATS projects. At the time of writing, I’m working on an update for Additional FH4/5/6 Transmissions to take advantage of some new features introduced in 1.60. It’s mainly backend, though, so you shouldn’t really notice much.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: ETS2/ATS Mod Status (1.60)
item.description:
Just over a month after the release of 1.59, 1.60 is available for American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2.

  • None of the vanilla S-Way Quick Jobs configs use metallic colors anymore, but they still don’t have retarders, so the overrides in ETS2-QJTI will stick.
  • Extra VNL Parts was updated to fix an issue where the newly added mirror text was just nonsense.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: ETS2/ATS Mod Status (1.59)
item.description:
Mods that rely on SCS localization string keys may have display issues in the games’ user interface with the 1.59 update. This affects some of my ETS2 mods.

It appears that all of my currently supported mods for American Truck Simulator work without issues with the 1.59 update.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: ETS2/ATS Mod Status (1.58)
item.description:
Since ATS 1.58 came out yesterday and ETS2 1.58 is apparently coming out tomorrow, figured I’d write this.

ETS2-QJTI release 26.01 has some issues with the 1.58 update. This is due to SCS changing some things around with the Scania R & S with this update. Older releases, however, should work fine. SCS already fixed the issue that version intended to fix, so that override will be removed with the next update anyway.

I will also need to verify if FH6 Headlight Guard Fix needs tweaking. UPDATE FEB 12, 2026: This mod is now obsolete with 1.58.

It appears that all other currently supported mods for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator work without issues with the 1.58 update.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: TruckyMods update
item.description:

item.title: ETS2 Mod Status (1.57 Open Beta)
item.description:
I’m not sure if any mods need updating at the moment – probably not. At the time I’m writing this, I’m currently downloading the open beta for ETS2 1.57.

Depending on how this update affects the Scania R and S Quick Job trucks, which were updated with this version, ETS2-QJTI may receive an update related to them. ETS2-QJTI never affected these trucks, so the current version should still work with 1.57.

You can see all mods here.

Long overdue, but it appears that all currently supported mods for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator work without issues with the 1.56 update.

item.title: Hell - ATS Kenworth T680 Next Gen
Rebrand
item.description:
A rebrand was long overdue.

But first, here’s the backstory of the original PV Creations logo.

The original logo

I created PV Creations’ original logo in 2021 on an app called Vectornator (now known as Linearity Curve). The logo comprises the letters “PVC” enclosed in a circle. The logo received a few tweaks over the years, but its fundamanetals remained unchanged. I originally intended that the logo was change color over time, but this was quickly abandoned and the original purple gradient stuck. This was later changed to a solid purple envisaged as an “in-between” of the two.

The original logo was never available in SVG format, not because of some technical limitation, but because 1. I didn’t know how to edit SVG files using a text editor (doesn’t help that TextEdit sucks) and 2. I never thought I’d need one.

At the end of 2023 I got a “new” Windows PC. Unfortunately Linearity Curve is only available for the iPad and Mac. I don’t have an iPad, and my Mac had become unbearably slow. I never took the opportunity to vectorize it, although I probably should’ve.

The new logo

Most importantly PV Creations’ new logo isn’t too different from the original, but I made a few changes:

  • Typeface: Agency FB replaces Poppins as the PVC logo’s font. A condensed font (at least on Windows), Agency FB takes up more vertical space within the circle, making the logo more visually appealing and – in my opinion, at least – proportional.

…and that’s about it. It’s already live as the Discord server’s icon and will be rolled out to other PVC outlets in due course. Let me know what you think in the Discord server!
